decisive_items: hyperreflective tissues starting to proliferate on retinal vessels
angiogenic sprouts showing flow signals extending vertically
response.rationale: Progressive proliferation on retinal vessels with vertical angiogenic sprouts and dendritic vascular structures supports retinal neovascularization; neovascular AMD would require choroidal/subretinal findings not supplied.

rejected.why: No drusen, subretinal fluid, or choroidal neovascular membrane findings; the described proliferations are on retinal vessels rather than subretinal.
